record.dic_text:
05830 `Ezra' {ez-ra:'}

SNH05833 的變異型; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Ezra 22; 22

以斯拉 = "幫助"
1) 在耶路撒冷帶領回歸的人認罪悔改的祭司和書記; 尼希米的同工 
2) 和所羅巴伯一起的一位祭司 (#尼 12:1,13|)
3) 另一位被擄後時代的猶太人 (#尼 12:33|)
record.edic_text:
05830 `Ezra' {ez-raw'}

a variation of 05833;; n pr m

AV - Ezra 22; 22

Ezra = "help"
1) the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles
   in Jerusalem; co-worker with Nehemiah
2) a priest with Zerubbabel
3) another post-exilic Jew
